tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. A cool paper white with a faint green bias toward `verde`; never cream.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: The reading column, panels, sheets and popovers that sit on `paper`.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Side rails (Índice, filters), table headers, the inactive track of controls.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between articles, panel borders, table rules. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, buttons and the date lens: carries meaning, ≥3:1 on `paper` and `paper-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Statute text and headings on `paper`, `paper-raised`, `paper-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — dates, epígrafes in lists, captions — on `paper`, `paper-raised`, `paper-sunken`.

tokens.name: revogado
tokens.usage: Revoked or expired provisions (revogado, caducado): their heading and pill, always with the word. Text-safe on `paper` and `paper-raised`.

tokens.name: verde
tokens.usage: The one brand accent (verde-garrafa): links, the current-version marker, primary buttons, the 'Em vigor' state. Text-safe on `paper` and `paper-raised`.

tokens.name: verde-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet fill behind the selected version, the active tab and the 'Em vigor' pill. Pair with `verde` text.

tokens.name: on-verde
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `verde` fill (primary buttons).

tokens.name: ins-ink
tokens.usage: Text that a change ADDED (aditado / nova redação), always with an underline. Reserved for changes; never UI chrome.

tokens.name: ins-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind added text. `ins-ink` and `ink` both stay ≥4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: del-ink
tokens.usage: Text that a change REMOVED (redação anterior / revogado), always struck through. Reserved for changes; never UI chrome or errors.

tokens.name: del-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind removed text. `del-ink` and `ink` both stay ≥4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: pendente
tokens.usage: Law in the making: pending iniciativas, projected text, process steps not yet reached. Text-safe on `paper` and `paper-raised`. Always with a dashed outline or the word 'Pendente'.

tokens.name: pendente-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind pending/projected text and the 'Pendente' pill. Pair with `pendente`.

tokens.name: aviso
tokens.usage: Trust warnings: 'Não verificado', default-date assumptions, retroactive effects ahead. Text-safe on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `aviso-bg`.

tokens.name: aviso-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a warning note or the 'Não verificado' pill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px outline at 2px offset. ≥3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: act-0
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: the original (versão originária) — a neutral band so later changes stand out.

tokens.name: act-1
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: the first amending act in the legend. Margin bands and swatches only; text written by the act stays `ink`.

tokens.name: act-2
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: second act. Margin band and swatch.

tokens.name: act-3
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: third act. Margin band and swatch.

tokens.name: act-4
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: fourth act. Margin band and swatch.

tokens.name: act-5
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: fifth act. Margin band and swatch.

tokens.name: act-6
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: sixth act. Margin band and swatch.

tokens.name: act-7
tokens.usage: Origem do texto: seventh act. Margin band and swatch.

families.serif: "Source Serif 4", "Source Serif Pro", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Diploma title on its landing page. Once per page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Article heading in the single-article view.

styles.name: article
styles.usage: Article heading inside a running diploma.

styles.name: statute
styles.sample: 1 — Constitui justa causa de despedimento o comportamento culposo do trabalhador…
styles.usage: The law itself. 19px desktop and phone, measure ≤ 68ch.

styles.name: statute-small
styles.sample: a) Desobediência ilegítima às ordens dadas por responsáveis hierarquicamente superiores;
styles.usage: Quoted law inside panels, diffs side-by-side, tooltips.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and section headings in the interface.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Este texto foi escrito pela Lei n.º 13/2023, de 3 de abril.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Em vigor desde 1 de maio de 2023

styles.name: id
styles.usage: ELI paths, content hashes, API fields. Professionals and API docs only — never in citizen flows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a pill's icon and word; between swatch and label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside pills and chips; between números of an article.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between items in a version list; button horizontal padding at small size.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on phone; side gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop; between articles.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top margin; between the diploma header and its first article.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Act swatches, ins/del tints — keeps marked text looking like ink, not buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the date lens, pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, sheets, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Only for floating layers: the Origem do texto sheet, popovers, the sticky date lens when scrolled. Panels on the page use `rule` borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the statute reading column.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Width of the Origem do texto margin band.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on phone for every control.
